author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Hardware engineers DON'T listen to this guy.  We still have our jobs while the software guys are eaten alive by AI because everything is open source in software.  The AI can learn how to replace humans.

Stay away from open source in silicon design.  Don't teach AI how to design its own brain.  You don't want Skynet, do you?  We are the last hope of humans.
